# möbius for macOS 0.2.1

A small update to the möbius Cloud section in Settings → Account.

- The plans are described in plain words: Cloud for everyday work, and Cloud Plus
  with a faster machine, more storage and four times the AI usage.
- Shorter copy throughout, with the age and AI notices in one line of fine print.
- Your plan's description shows once you're subscribed.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Works with the same gateway (0.15.53,
protocol 86) as 0.2.0; no re-pairing needed.
